verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents user-created custom Unified Controls for tracking and implementing controls it doesn't offer, and these sit alongside the built-in, auditor-mapped Unified Controls. That covers the custom-controls part of the story. The evidence says nothing about creating custom frameworks, writing your own automated tests or monitors for those controls, or defining custom evidence requirements. Missing for 10: custom framework creation, user-defined tests/monitors on custom controls, custom evidence requirements, any detail on custom-control configuration beyond a single mention, independent corroboration.
